speakers.name: Robert A. Dees Memorial Scholarship
speakers.title: For undergraduate or graduate ME students
speakers.bio: Memorial scholarship for Mechanical Engineering students at San José State University, originally established by his mother, Debbie Hammond.

speakers.name: S. Brooks Walton Scholarship
speakers.title: For seniors or graduate ME students
speakers.bio: Named after SJSU's first engineering faculty member, this award recognizes the outstanding graduate of the year, and two additional students demonstrating promise and achievement in the field.

speakers.name: Mark A. Pasquale Scholarship
speakers.title: For undergraduate and graduate ME students
speakers.bio: Awarded to students majoring in Mechanical Engineering, encouraging excellence in academics, leadership, and community involvement.

speakers.name: David A. Brown Fellowship in Mechatronics Scholarship
speakers.title: For juniors, seniors, or graduate ME students
speakers.bio: Promotes professional development in Mechatronics and supports the SJSU Mechatronics program. Eligibility: ME106 or ME285 (or equivalent) prior to Spring 2025.

speakers.name: Francis Huang Memorial Scholarship in Engineering
speakers.title: For juniors, seniors, or graduate ME students
speakers.bio: Memorial scholarship for Mechanical Engineering students demonstrating dedication to the field and a commitment to academic achievement.

speakers.name: Mechanical Engineering Graduate of the Year
speakers.title: For ME graduating seniors or master's students with demonstrated overall excellence
speakers.bio: Departmental scholarship recognizing academic excellence in Mechanical Engineering.
